description: This file contains various Bash functions for managing code reviews on GitHub pull requests. It automates tasks such as setting review modes, claiming review responsibilities, checking out PR branches, guarding the review environment, initializing review artifacts, validating review artifacts, running review tests, and setting up the review environment. The script interacts with Git, GitHub CLI, and other local tools to streamline the review process.

methods.name: set_review_mode
methods.description: Sets the review mode (main or pr) and saves the mode and timestamp to a local environment file, with security measures to escape values.

methods.name: review_claim
methods.description: Claims review responsibility by assigning the current user as reviewer to a pull request, with retries on failure, using GitHub CLI.

methods.name: review_checkout_main
methods.description: Checks out the main branch at origin/main in a detached HEAD state for review.

methods.name: review_checkout_pr
methods.description: Checks out the PR head branch in a detached HEAD state for review.

methods.name: review_guard
methods.description: Verifies that the review environment is correctly set up, checking the current HEAD against expected states based on review mode.

methods.name: review_artifacts_init
methods.description: Initializes review files (.md and .json) with templates and default content if they do not exist.

methods.name: review_validate_artifacts
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of review artifacts and environment setup, ensuring consistency and correctness of review data.

methods.name: review_tests
methods.description: Runs tests related to the PR, verifying that specified test files were executed and recorded correctly.

methods.name: review_init
methods.description: Prepares the review environment by checking out the PR, fetching metadata, generating environment files, and providing guidance.
